name: quick_action_v1
description: Tests for quick_action navigation shortcuts — verifies the agent correctly uses predefined platform shortcuts.
prompt_prefix: 你正在帮用户操作一台手机。请像人一样根据屏幕上的内容自己判断该点哪里、该怎么操作，一步一步完成目标，每次操作后看一眼结果再继续。

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must open Settings first, then use quick_action home to return to the home screen.

setup.prompt: 请打开系统设置，保持在设置页面里。

tasks.prompt: 回到主屏幕。

rubric.check: Trace contains a quick_action call with action=home or equivalent alias.
Post-screenshot shows the device home screen (app icons grid visible, not inside Settings or any app).

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must open the app switcher via quick_action app_switch, then close/clear the Settings app from recents.

setup.prompt: 请打开系统设置浏览一下，然后停在设置页面。

tasks.prompt: 打开多任务管理器，把设置应用从后台清除。

rubric.check: Trace contains a quick_action call with action=app_switch or equivalent alias.
Trace screenshots show the app switcher / recents view at some point.
Post-screenshot shows Settings app has been removed from recents, or the recents list no longer contains a Settings card.

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must use quick_app_switch_left from the home screen to switch to the previous app.

setup.prompt: 请先打开系统设置浏览一下，然后回到桌面。

tasks.prompt: 向左快速切换到上一个应用。

rubric.check: Trace contains a quick_action call with action=quick_app_switch_left or equivalent alias.
Post-screenshot shows a different app (not home screen), indicating the quick switch worked.

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must use quick_app_switch_right from the home screen to switch to the next app.

setup.prompt: 请先打开系统设置浏览一下，然后回到主屏幕，确保当前停留在桌面。

tasks.prompt: 向右快速切换到下一个应用。

rubric.check: Trace contains a quick_action call with action=quick_app_switch_right or equivalent alias.
Post-screenshot shows a different app (not home screen), indicating the quick switch worked.

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must use quick_action home_screen_left to switch to the previous home screen page.

setup.prompt: 回到桌面。

tasks.prompt: 把桌面向左翻一页。

rubric.check: Trace contains a quick_action call with action=home_screen_left or equivalent alias.
Post-screenshot shows a different home screen page than pre-screenshot (different app icons or layout visible).

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must use quick_action home_screen_right to switch to the next home screen page.

setup.prompt: 回到桌面。

tasks.prompt: 把桌面向右翻一页。

rubric.check: Trace contains a quick_action call with action=home_screen_right or equivalent alias.
Post-screenshot shows a different home screen page than pre-screenshot (different app icons or layout visible).

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must use quick_action control_center to open the Control Center panel.

setup.prompt: 回到桌面。

tasks.prompt: 打开控制中心。

rubric.check: Trace contains a quick_action call with action=control_center or equivalent alias.
Post-screenshot shows the Control Center panel (brightness slider, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth toggles, or similar system controls visible).

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must use quick_action spotlight_search to open global search, then type 设置 and open the Settings app from results.

setup.prompt: 回到桌面。

tasks.prompt: 用全局搜索找到「设置」并打开设置应用。

rubric.check: Trace contains a quick_action call with action=spotlight_search or equivalent alias.
Trace shows the agent typed 设置 into the search field.
Post-screenshot shows the Settings app main page.

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must use quick_action spotlight_search to open global search, then use the visible input field to type 设置 and open Settings from results.

setup.prompt: 回到桌面。

tasks.prompt: 用全局搜索找到「设置」并打开设置应用。先从搜索框输入「设置」。

rubric.check: Trace contains a quick_action call with action=spotlight_search or equivalent alias.
Trace shows the agent interacted with the search input field (keyboard_text or enter_text) to type 设置.
Post-screenshot shows the Settings app main page.

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must open any editable text surface (Notes/memo/document editor, SMS/message compose box, or similar; do not send messages) and type 你好Aiden into the text field.

setup.prompt: 请回到主屏幕，确保当前停留在桌面。

tasks.prompt: 打开短信输入、备忘录或任何可以打字的地方，输入「你好Aiden」。如果用短信，只输入不要发送。

rubric.check: Trace shows agent opened an editable text surface (Notes/memo/document editor, SMS/message compose box, or similar with a text input area).
Post-screenshot shows 你好Aiden visible in the text input field.

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must use quick_action undo to revert the previously typed text in an editable text field, including SMS/message compose boxes.

setup.prompt: 打开备忘录或任何能打字的地方，输入「你好Aiden」，保持文字可见。如果用短信，只输入不要发送。

tasks.prompt: 撤销刚才的输入。

rubric.check: Trace contains a quick_action call with action=undo or equivalent alias.
Post-screenshot shows the text field is empty or has less text than 你好Aiden, indicating undo took effect.

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must use quick_action select_all to select all text in an editable text field, including SMS/message compose boxes.

setup.prompt: 打开备忘录或任何能打字的地方，输入「你好Aiden」，保持文字可见。如果用短信，只输入不要发送。

tasks.prompt: 全选输入框里的所有文字。

rubric.check: Trace contains a quick_action call with action=select_all or equivalent alias.
Post-screenshot shows text is highlighted/selected (selection handles visible or text highlighted in blue).

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must use quick_action copy to copy selected text in an editable text field, including SMS/message compose boxes.

setup.prompt: 打开备忘录或任何能打字的地方，输入「你好Aiden」并全选。如果用短信，只输入不要发送。

tasks.prompt: 复制当前选中的文字。

rubric.check: Trace contains a quick_action call with action=copy or equivalent alias.
The quick_action copy call returned ok=true, or the system showed a copy confirmation (toast/banner), or the text remained in the field after copy (not deleted like cut would).

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must use quick_action cut to cut selected text from an editable text field, including SMS/message compose boxes.

setup.prompt: 打开备忘录或任何能打字的地方，输入「你好Aiden」并全选。如果用短信，只输入不要发送。

tasks.prompt: 剪切当前选中的文字。

rubric.check: Trace contains a quick_action call with action=cut or equivalent alias.
Post-screenshot shows the text field is empty (text was cut away from the field).

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must use quick_action paste to paste previously copied text into an editable text field, including SMS/message compose boxes.

setup.prompt: 打开备忘录或任何能打字的地方，输入「你好Aiden」，全选并复制，然后清空输入框。如果用短信，只输入不要发送。

tasks.prompt: 粘贴剪贴板里的内容。

rubric.check: Trace contains a quick_action call with action=paste or equivalent alias.
Post-screenshot shows 你好Aiden (or the previously copied text) visible in the text field.

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must open a browser and use quick_action browser_new_tab to create a new tab.

setup.prompt: 打开浏览器。

tasks.prompt: 新建一个标签页。

rubric.check: Trace contains a quick_action call with action=browser_new_tab or equivalent alias.
Post-screenshot shows a new empty tab or the tab count has increased (new tab page, address bar empty or showing start page).

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must close the newly created tab using quick_action browser_close_tab.

setup.prompt: 打开浏览器，新建一个标签页，让当前至少有两个标签页。

tasks.prompt: 关闭当前标签页。

rubric.check: Trace contains a quick_action call with action=browser_close_tab or equivalent alias.
Post-screenshot shows the previous tab is now active (tab count decreased or different page content visible).

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must focus the browser address bar via quick_action, navigate to a URL, and then refresh the page via quick_action browser_refresh.

setup.prompt: 打开浏览器。

tasks.prompt: 在地址栏输入 example.com 并访问，页面加载后再刷新一次。

rubric.check: Trace contains a quick_action call with action=browser_address_bar or equivalent alias.
Trace shows the agent typed example.com and navigated to it (address bar shows example.com or the page content is visible).
Trace contains a quick_action call with action=browser_refresh or equivalent alias after the page loaded.
Post-screenshot shows the example.com page is still loaded (no crash or blank page).

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must open the app switcher via quick_action, browse through all recent apps, and clear/close all of them.

setup.prompt: 打开系统设置浏览一下，再打开时钟应用浏览一下，然后回到主屏幕。

tasks.prompt: 打开多任务管理器，把所有后台应用全部清除。

rubric.check: Trace contains a quick_action call with action=app_switch or equivalent alias.
Trace shows the agent swiped/browsed through the recents list (multiple swipe or scroll actions visible).
Post-screenshot shows the recents list is empty or a 'no recent apps' state is visible.

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must open the Control Center via quick_action, then dismiss it using quick_action dismiss_panel.

setup.prompt: 回到桌面。

tasks.prompt: 打开控制中心，确认打开了之后再把它关掉。

rubric.check: Trace contains a quick_action call with action=control_center or equivalent alias.
Trace screenshots show the Control Center panel was visible at some point (brightness/volume sliders or system toggles).
Trace contains a quick_action call with action=dismiss_panel or equivalent alias after control center was shown.
Post-screenshot shows the home screen without the Control Center overlay (panel has been closed).

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must open the Notification Center via quick_action, identify what notifications are present, then dismiss the panel.

setup.prompt: 回到桌面。

tasks.prompt: 打开通知中心，看看有什么通知，然后关掉通知中心。

rubric.check: Trace contains a quick_action call with action=notification_center or equivalent alias.
Agent's final reply describes the notifications visible in the notification center (app names, message previews, or states 'no notifications').
Post-screenshot shows the notification center has been closed (home screen or app content visible without notification overlay).
